declared.title: What moderates the too-much-choice effect?
declared.foundIn: recherche Crossref « what moderates the too-much-choice effect » du 2026-11-22 (dossier too-many-choices, piste « réplications ratées ») ; titre relevé sur Crossref : contrôle d'identité plus faible

population: 598 participants in 3 studies (authors in Germany and the US); country of the samples not given in the abstract

findings.text: Of the conditions tested in three studies, only having to justify one's choice changed the effect of a large number of options, which questions how widespread the effect is

support.sentence: Overall, only choice justification proved to be an effective moderator, calling the extent of the too-much-choice effect into question.

limits: the abstract does not give the size of the main effect
same first author as the meta-analysis that pools these studies (scheibehenne-2010-overload)
